text:
Alex: Did anyone else set autopick to 'panic mode' or was that just me?
Nora: Panic mode? That sounds terrifying. What does it do, auto-sign a backup kicker? :laughing: 
Ben: It picks the highest projected points at 3am while youre asleep. Very scientific.
league-bot: autopick activated for Alex at 03:04AM -> priority low.
Alex: Low priority, yes. Still somehow stole my TE waiver. Smh.
Jonah: I can offer a trade: my TE (M. Ortiz) + homemade cookies for your mystery waiver pick. Cookies = 5 sweet points.
Nora: Cookies accepted if gluten-free. Trade collateral matters.
Ben: Also can we ban 3am autopicks unless you post a photo of your sleepy face? New rule proposal.
Alex: I would rather get the TE back than the selfie. But fine, Ill send a sleepy selfie if it gets me Ortiz.
league-bot: trade proposed: Jonah -> Alex: M. Ortiz for waiver-pick-X. Status: pending commish approval.
Nora: Vote: Allow sleepy-selfie reclaim? :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no.
Ben: Thumbsup. Keeps things entertaining.
Alex: Shoutout to @Jonah for offering cookies. If trade passes, Ill bring coffee to the next retro.
league-bot: reminder: playoffs in 14 days. Good luck and may your bench be patient.
